text:
Maya R: Hey @channel — Lucent (retail) submitted an onboarding ask. They want a custom intent reranker for product queries (rank by purchase intent). Requirements: token-level PII/PHI redaction, on-prem HSM for keys, private VPC deployment, and latency target ~50ms p50. Pilot requested in ~6 weeks. Intake form: https://redwood.internal/LC-2045 :eyes:

ops-bot: Intake created LC-2045 — assigned to Maya R and tagged customer-success, eng, security

Ethan L: Quick q — do we know model size/architecture? 7B/13B or something custom? affects memory/quant plan

Maya R: Lucent prefers a 7B finetuned reranker (instruction-tuned base). Dataset ~200k query pairs from them. We recommended int8 quantized 7B for cost. Latency SLOs: 50ms p50, 120ms p95.

Priya S: A few clarifying q's: is any PHI expected in those queries? PCI or healthcare scope? Also we need HSM spec (vendor/model) for key wrapping.

Maya R: No healthcare, but some queries include customer emails/phone numbers -> considered PII. They insist no model outputs or logs leave their VPC. HSM vendor is Thales (customer-provided).

Marco D: Routing/infra note — Private (VPC) + HSM should be fine, but HSM integration requires our private control plane ticket and onboarding. Quantization + CPU fallback could push p95 up; we'll need perf eval on quantized model. Can we get a 1k sample holdout for perf/quality runs?

Ethan L: I'll spin up the perf harness once we have samples. Need sample prompt format + labels and expected metric (e.g., NDCG@5). Also need target concurrent QPS for infra sizing.

Maya R: Sharing sample CSV in Drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/LC-2045/samples.csv — they expect 200 QPS steady, burst to 400. NDCG@5 target >= 0.45 on their holdout. Critical: no user PII may be persisted outside VPC; must be redacted before logs/metrics leave.

Priya S: I'll prepare a compliance checklist + MOU language for data residency and key ownership. HSM-integration will require us to validate certificate provisioning and KMS calls. Will start draft.

Marco D: Timeline? Lucent wants a pilot in 6 weeks. Realistic?

Ethan L: Rough break down: data ingestion & validation (1 wk), fine-tune (2 wks), quantization & perf runs (1 wk), infra + HSM integration + canary (2 wks). 6 wks is tight but doable if no major blockers.

Maya R: OK — I'll get Lucent to sign the MOU and drop the sample pairs by EOD tomorrow. @ops-bot please add an intake checklist flag for HSM on-prem and data residency.

ops-bot: Checklist LC-2045 updated: flags=[HSM_ON_PREM,DATA_RESIDENCY], tasks added: ["Create Private deployment request (assign: Marco D)", "Legal MOU draft (assign: Priya S)", "Perf harness run (assign: Ethan L)"]

Priya S: Thanks — looping Legal now. Will post draft in #legal-review when ready.

Marco D: I'll start the perf harness plan and list recommended instance types. Ethan — can you prep an infra template (private deployment) I can reuse?

Ethan L: :thumbsup: I'll drop a runbook + instance recommendations (A100-ish GPU fleet + 2x CPUs for quant fallback) in this thread tomorrow morning.

Maya R: Great — I'll update Lucent on plan and timeline. Will follow up with a short kickoff meeting invite once MOU is signed. :calendar:
